name: AuraStudio Pro ANC Wireless Headphones
shortDescription: Active noise cancellation, 45-hour ultra battery life, custom 40mm beryllium drivers, and breathable memory foam ear cushions.
description: Immerse yourself in concert-hall acoustic fidelity with the AuraStudio Pro. Engineered with hybrid active noise cancellation (ANC) and quad-microphone beamforming arrays, it filters out ambient distractions with pinpoint accuracy. The ergonomic aerospace-grade aluminum headband and plush memory foam earcups deliver day-long comfort.
features: 45-Hour playback with ultra-fast charging (10 min = 5 hours)
Quad-mic environmental noise cancellation for crystal-clear calls

reviews.author: Alexander Wright
reviews.title: Best ANC headphones I have ever owned!
reviews.comment: The noise cancellation completely silences coffee shop chatter and jet engine hum. The audio profile is crisp with rich bass without being muddy.

reviews.author: Sophia Chen
reviews.title: Extremely comfortable for 8+ hour workdays
reviews.comment: I wear these while coding all day. No ear fatigue or pressure on the crown of my head. 10/10 build quality.
